fact: The tax administration (DGI) is rolling out a new NIU portal, niu.harmony2.cm, whose registration is announced as taking under five minutes with AI pre-filling; the verification, retrieval and authentication modules were already working at the time of testing and the end of registration was still under development.
title: Nouveau portail NIU (niu.harmony2.cm) : vérifier un NIU, retrouver son numéro, télécharger l'attestation — et la liste de tous les CFLP
